about.title: About This Project
about.lead: A minimal, fully-typed SSR starter using Vite 8, React 19, React Router 7, TypeScript, and i18n.

i18n.title: How i18n Works
i18n.step1: The server detects the locale from the Accept-Language header (or cookie)
i18n.step2: The matching JSON file is loaded and passed into renderToString()
i18n.step3: The locale and translations are serialized into a <script> tag in the HTML
i18n.step4: The client reads from that script tag — no extra fetch needed
i18n.step5: Switching language updates the context and re-renders instantly
